title: Stephen Krashen on Language Acquisition
summary: A 15-minute clip of linguist Stephen Krashen discussing language acquisition, drawn from the 1980s. It presents his input hypothesis and the distinction between acquisition and learning.
why: Cited as the source for comprehensible input, the principle behind immersion-based language learning methods and apps.

quote.text: Their method is based on Stephen Krashen's "language acquisition through comprehensible input"[1] and... it just works.
